app.name: Ardea
app.tagline: Understand the risk. Know what matters. Act immediately.

errors.offline: Ardea’s server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.

overview.emptyText: Once sources are synced and a project describes what it runs, open actions and their deadlines appear here.

actions.emptyText: An action appears when a vulnerability affects a component of one of your projects.

vulnerabilities.emptyText: Every consolidated entry from every source appears here after the first sync, whether it affects you or not.

projects.emptyText: A project describes what you run, so Ardea can tell which vulnerabilities affect it.

sources.emptyText: Each source shows here when it last synced and whether it is healthy.

rules.emptyText: Rules decide who hears about which actions, by email, push or webhook.

team.emptyText: Members, their roles and open invitations appear here.

settings.emptyText: The organization, its deadlines and its AI data policy will be set here.

administration.emptyText: Registration, mail, AI providers and background jobs of this instance will be managed here.

noOrganization.title: Welcome
noOrganization.heading: You are not in an organization yet
noOrganization.text: Ask someone in your organization to invite you. The link in their email adds you to it.
noOrganization.textAdmin: This instance has no organization yet. The setup wizard that creates one is not part of this version yet.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.heading: There is nothing at this address
notFound.text: The link may be old, or the page belongs to an organization you are not part of.

unavailable.title: Ardea is not reachable
unavailable.text: The server did not answer. It may be restarting or your connection may be down.

email.label: Email
email.invalid: Enter an email address, such as name@example.org.

displayName.label: Name
displayName.hint: Shown to your team next to what you change.
displayName.required: Enter the name your team knows you by.

newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.hint: At least 12 characters. A few words in a row are easy to remember.
newPassword.weak: This password is too easy to guess. Choose a longer one, or a few unrelated words.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lead: See what affects your projects and what to do about it.

notices.passwordChanged: Your password is changed. Sign in with the new one.
notices.registered: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
notices.twoFactorExpired: The sign-in took too long. Enter your email and password again.

errors.invalid: The email address or the password is not right.
errors.lockedOut: Too many failed attempts. This account is locked for a few minutes.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.lead: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
twoFactor.leadRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-factor authentication. Each code works once.

errors.codeRequired: Enter the code from your app.
errors.expired: The sign-in took too long. Start again.
errors.invalid: That code did not work. Wait for the next one and check that your device’s clock is right.
errors.invalidRecovery: That recovery code did not work. It may have been used already.

setup.title: Set up Ardea
setup.lead: Create the first account. It becomes the administrator of this instance.
setup.tokenHint: The one-time token from the server’s log at its first start.

errors.tokenInvalid: This setup token is not right. Copy it again from the server’s log.
errors.completed: This instance is already set up. Sign in instead.
errors.rejected: The account could not be created. Check the entries and try again.

register.title: Create your account
register.lead: You were invited to Ardea. Choose how you will sign in.
register.emailHint: Use the address the invitation was sent to.

missing.heading: This invitation link is incomplete
missing.text: Open the link from the invitation email again, or ask the person who invited you to send a new one.

errors.invitation: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask the person who invited you to send a new one.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email address exists already. Sign in instead.
errors.rejected: The account could not be created. Check the entries and try again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.

sent.heading: Check your inbox
sent.text: If an account exists for {email}, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It is valid for a limited time.

errors.failed: The link could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.lead: For {email}. You will sign in with it from now on.

missing.heading: This link is incomplete
missing.text: Open the link from the email again, or request a new one.

errors.linkInvalid: This link has expired or was used already.
errors.rejected: The password could not be changed. Check it and try again.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.sub: A code from an app on your phone, in addition to your password.

on.heading: Two-factor authentication is on
on.text: You sign in with your password and a code from your authenticator app.

intro.heading: Protect your account with a second step
intro.text: Someone who learns your password still cannot sign in without your phone. Any authenticator app works, such as the one built into your password manager.
intro.passwordHint: To protect your account, confirm it is you.

scan.heading: Add Ardea to your authenticator app
scan.text: Scan the code with your authenticator app. If you cannot scan it, enter the key by hand.
scan.qrLabel: QR code to add Ardea to your authenticator app

confirm.heading: Enter the code the app shows

codes.heading: Save your recovery codes
codes.text: Each code signs you in once if you lose your phone. Keep them somewhere safe, such as your password manager. They are shown only now.
codes.fileHeader: Ardea recovery codes. Each code works once.

errors.codeRequired: Enter the code from your app.
errors.invalid: That code did not work. Wait for the next one and check that your phone’s clock is right.
errors.failed: Two-factor authentication could not be set up. Try again in a moment.
